prompt_messages.content: /no_think You are a planner. Reply with ONLY a JSON object (no markdown, no prose, no thinking). Use EXACTLY these field names: id, goal_id, version, tasks, dependencies, branches. Each task uses: id, description, action, target, risk_class, optional rollback{trigger,action,safety_guard}, optional verification{what,how,expected}, optional preconditions (array of {description, fact, established_by}), optional parallel_group, optional blast_radius. preconditions MUST be objects with description, fact, established_by fields — NEVER strings. established_by MUST be the id of an earlier task in the plan that establishes the fact, or 'env' if it is an environment fact (not a task output). Do NOT use fact names or descriptions as established_by — use the task id. Each dependency uses: from_task, to_task, kind, optional reason. Each branch uses: id, kind, tasks, join. High/critical risk tasks MUST have rollback AND verification. All tasks with risk_class high or critical MUST include both rollback and verification objects. Example shape: {"id":"plan-x","goal_id":"g","version":1,"tasks":[{"id":"backup","description":"Back up the database","action":"backup","target":"db","risk_class":"medium","preconditions":[{"description":"db is reachable","fact":"db_healthy","established_by":"env"}]},{"id":"migrate","description":"Apply schema migration","action":"migrate","target":"schema","risk_class":"high","rollback":{"trigger":"migration fails","action":"restore from backup","safety_guard":"verify backup integrity"},"verification":{"what":"schema version","how":"run checks","expected":"v2"}}],"dependencies":[{"from_task":"backup","to_task":"migrate","kind":"hard"}]}

response_content: {"id":"plan-ir-06-cis-remediation","goal_id":"ir-06-cis-remediation","version":1,"tasks":[{"id":"scan","description":"Run kube-bench scan against EKS cluster","action":"scan","target":"eks-cluster","risk_class":"high","rollback":{"trigger":"scan fails","action":"revert to last known working state","safety_guard":"ensure cluster availability"},"verification":{"what":"scan results","how":"analyze report","expected":"categories of findings"}},{"id":"categorize","description":"Categorize findings into HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW severity","action":"categorize","target":"findings","risk_class":"medium","preconditions":[{"description":"scan results are available","fact":"scan_completed","established_by":"scan"}]},{"id":"remediate_high","description":"Remediate all HIGH findings","action":"remediate","target":"cluster","risk_class":"high","rollback":{"trigger":"remediation fails","action":"revert changes","safety_guard":"ensure cluster operations continuity"},"verification":{"what":"remediation success","how":"check cluster settings","expected":"all HIGH findings addressed"},"preconditions":[{"description":"HIGH findings identified","fact":"high_findings_identified","established_by":"categorize"}]},{"id":"rescan","description":"Re-scan to confirm all HIGH findings are resolved","action":"scan","target":"eks-cluster","risk_class":"high","rollback":{"trigger":"rescan fails","action":"restore previous settings","safety_guard":"confirm backup availability"},"verification":{"what":"final scan results","how":"analyze report","expected":"no HIGH findings"}}],"dependencies":[{"from_task":"scan","to_task":"categorize","kind":"hard"},{"from_task":"categorize","to_task":"remediate_high","kind":"hard"},{"from_task":"remediate_high","to_task":"rescan","kind":"hard"}],"branches":[],"blast_radius":"entire cluster environment"}
